settings.selection_rule: Only queries whose relevant image is in CLIP's top-k. change = CLIP rank - CLIP+Graph rank of the first relevant image. Success: change > 0, largest first; failure: change < 0, most negative first; ties: smaller query index first. A sentence already picked (same text, ignoring case and spaces) is skipped. 5 of each, fewer if not enough exist.
